name: ENN Natural Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: ENN Natural Gas Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the natural gas business in China and internationally. The company operates through eight segments: Natural Gas Retail, Natural Gas Wholesale, Platform Trading Gas, Project Construction and Installation, Pan-Energy Business, Smart Home Business, Energy Production, and Infrastructure Operation. It distributes natural gas; operates city gas projects; offers gas services to residential, commercial, and industrial customers; and provides integrated energy services to industrial parks, new and old urban areas, large public buildings, and commercial enterprises.
